newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 25.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto unveils new policy on Russia.
-- Major Japanese and foreign chip makers to join hands to produce dynamic random-access memory (DRAMs) chips.
-- 80 percent support dispatch of Self-Defence Force planes to rescue Japanese abroad.
-- Vehicle production rises 12 percent in first half of fiscal 1997/98.
-- Health and Welfare ministry issues warning against food poisoning with flu-like symptoms.
-- Daiwa Securities Co Ltd, Securities Co Ltd and Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd to be investigated on suspicion of illegal payments to corporate racketeer.
